title: The Ancestor Returns
text: The crypt door was open this morning. An ancestor of your House sits at the head of your table in her burial clothes, asking for wine. She knows every servant's name and wants her old room back. She has come to help, she says.

options.label: Welcome her home; she was of the House.

outcomes.text: She takes up her old room and sits in on the House's councils, where her advice is excellent. She neither eats nor sleeps, and the House's younger ones will not go past her door.

options.label: Have a Scion walk her gently back to the crypt, where she belongs.

outcomes.text: Your Scion takes her arm and walks her down, talking of old times. She lies back down with a sigh, leaving them a ring and a blessing.
She does not want to go back. It takes your Scion all night, and they come up the crypt stairs with her fingerprints bruised black into their arm.

options.label: Lock the doors and wait for her to leave; the dead have no seat at this table.

outcomes.text: All night she knocks politely on every door in the Seat. In the morning she is gone, but the crypt door is still open.
